methodology.text: How this directory was built: Method & Vetting
Example methodology tab generated by build_directory.py. All providers on this example tab are fictional.

Mined a local investor Facebook group (in-group search per trade; harvested self-promoters + recommendation-thread comments), then cross-referenced every name against Google/BBB reviews and the state license board. Unverifiable fields say 'not found' on purpose.
Strongest signal: cross-validation. When two different members name the same company (here, Ridgeline Electric), call that one first.
How to vet before you hire

Verify the license on the relevant state board, ask for a COI (general liability + workers' comp) from their agent, check the review COUNT (not just the stars), and get 2-3 investor references. For 'Confirm' rows, the first call question is: 'Do you service Blount / Maryville as well as Knox?'
Never trust a found or AI-generated list at face value. Verify every phone and license; these lists routinely contain wrong numbers and out-of-area businesses.

reference_tabs.subtitle: Call the district that owns the main FIRST. Ask the tap fee and whether it's a short or long-side tap (long-side = you pay the road bore).

DIFFERENT: your contractor installs the line AND makes the connection to the board's main.
reference_tabs.footnote: These are utilities, not contractors. They set the tap/meter; your excavator or plumber runs the service line. Fees here are illustrative; always call the district for the current schedule.
